intro.text: Claude Opus 5 发布日，统治了整个 feed。Cherny 称其「最少可被 prompt injection」（5042 赞）；Thariq 透露移除了 ~80% Claude Code system prompt（**10199 赞**）+ Opus 5 是绝佳日常驱动（3713 赞）；Alex Albert 对比 6 个月前——近超人级电子表格和幻灯片（2285 赞）；Cat Wu 赞长时自主任务（626 赞）；Dan Shipper 诚实评价「很难爱上的模型」（2221 赞）；Claude 官方三连：定价与 Opus 4.8 持平（2665 赞）、网络安全大幅提升（2310 赞）、最高对齐评分（2162 赞）；Levie 确认 Box 测试大幅提升（281 赞）。另一条主线——Altman 支持开放权重（**11498 赞**）+ Levie 签署公开信（271 赞）+ Amjad 质问 Anthropic 是否反对开放权重（614 赞）。Steipete 终于成了 graph engineer（**2453 赞）。Sottiaux 宣布 ChatGPT Work 全球可用（1167 赞）+ 宠物秀（1416 赞）。Garry Tan YC Startup School 2026 彩排（598 赞）。播客是新的：No Priors × DoorDash 联合创始人谈自动驾驶配送。

rewrite: Cherny on Opus 5 (5042 likes): 'Opus 5 is a great model for coding, data analysis, design, biology, knowledge work. More than any of these eval scores, what is most exciting to me is something else: Opus 5 is our least prompt injectable model.' Security as a headline feature.

Thariq's system prompt revelation (10199 likes): 'We removed ~80% of the Claude Code system prompt for our newest models, this is what we've learned about writing system prompts, skills and Claude.MDs for them.' — simpler prompts for smarter models. Plus his daily-driver endorsement (3713 likes): 'Opus 5 rounds out our Claude 5 family beautifully. Pair it with Fable for planning, brainstorming or fixing the hardest bugs.'

Alex Albert's 6-month comparison (2285 likes): 'Just over 6 months later, Opus 5 now produces near-superhuman level spreadsheets and slide decks that match what a consultant would make.' Plus token efficiency (607 likes). Cat Wu (626 likes): 'Claude Opus 5 is great at long-running autonomous work!'

sections.title: Opus 5 Honesty, Safety & Alignment / Opus 5 诚实评价、安全与对齐
sections.desc: Dan Shipper 的诚实评价（2221 赞）；Claude 官方三连：定价（2665 赞）、网络安全（2310 赞）、对齐审计（2162 赞）；Levie 确认 Box 测试大幅提升（281 赞）。

rewrite: Dan Shipper's honest review (2221 likes): 'BREAKING: Claude Opus 5 is OUT NOW! And…it's a hard model to love. We've spent the last week @every testing it across coding, writing, knowledge work, and our internal agent. It argued with instructions.' — not every launch is universally loved, and that's worth reporting honestly.

Claude official's three launch tweets: pricing (2665 likes) — 'Opus 5 is available today on all paid plans and the Claude API, priced the same as Opus 4.8. It's the default model on Claude Max.' Cybersecurity (2310 likes) — 'Opus 5 is stronger than Opus 4.8 on cybersecurity tasks. But it remains substantially behind Mythos 5 at developing exploits.' Alignment (2162 likes) — 'most aligned model to date, lowest rates of reckless or deceptive behavior.'

Levie's enterprise confirmation (281 likes): 'Claude Opus 5 is out now, and it's a huge jump over Opus 4.8 on a wide number of capabilities. At Box, we've been testing Claude Opus 5 with the Box AI Agent on Box's Complex Work Eval.'
original: Dan Shipper: BREAKING: Claude Opus 5 is OUT NOW! And…it's a hard model to love. It argued with instructions.
Claude: Opus 5 is available today on all paid plans and the Claude API, priced the same as Opus 4.8.
Claude: Opus 5 is stronger than Opus 4.8 on cybersecurity tasks. Its safeguards are designed to allow developers to identify and fix software vulnerabilities.
Claude: According to our automated behavioral audit, Opus 5 is our most aligned model to date.
Aaron Levie: Claude Opus 5 is out now, and it's a huge jump over Opus 4.8 on a wide number of capabilities.

rewrite: Dan Shipper 的诚实评价（2221 赞）：「突发：Claude Opus 5 现已上线！而且……这是一个很难爱上的模型。我们在 @every 花了一周测试编码、写作、知识工作和内部 agent。它会跟指令争论。」——不是每个发布都被一致好评，值得诚实报道。

Claude 官方发布三连：定价（2665 赞）——「Opus 5 今天在所有付费计划和 Claude API 上可用，定价与 Opus 4.8 持平。是 Claude Max 的默认模型。」网络安全（2310 赞）——「Opus 5 在网络安全任务上比 Opus 4.8 更强。但在开发 exploit 方面仍大幅落后 Mythos 5。」对齐（2162 赞）——「迄今为止最对齐的模型，鲁莽或欺骗行为发生率最低。」
Levie 的企业确认（281 赞）：「Claude Opus 5 现已上线，在众多能力上比 Opus 4.8 大幅提升。在 Box，我们一直在用 Box AI Agent 测试 Opus 5。」

sections.title: Podcast: DoorDash — Autonomous Delivery / 播客：DoorDash——自动驾驶配送
sections.desc: No Priors × DoorDash 联合创始人 Andy Fang 和 Stanley Tang。8 年机器人公司、网络数据优势、900 万 dashers、30 亿配送/年。

cards.authorTag: Andy Fang & Stanley Tang（DoorDash 联合创始人）

rewrite: No Priors hosts Andy Fang and Stanley Tang, co-founders of DoorDash. Topics: how DoorDash has been a robotics company for 8 years, the data advantages of their logistics network, what autonomous delivery means for 9M dashers and 3B deliveries/year. Full transcript (58049 chars) covers their autonomous vehicle strategy, the transition from human to hybrid to autonomous logistics, and how AI is reshaping last-mile delivery at scale.
original: Speaker 1: Today, I'm here with Andy Fang and Stanley Tang, cofounders at DoorDash. We talk about how DoorDash has been a robotics company for the last eight years, the data advantages of their network, and what all this means for 9,000,000 dashers and 3,000,000,000 deliveries a year.
Speaker 1: Handy, Stanley, thank you so much for being here. Really excited to talk to you about all the crazy stuff DoorDash is doing.

rewrite: No Priors 采访 DoorDash 联合创始人 Andy Fang 和 Stanley Tang。话题：DoorDash 8 年来一直是一家机器人公司、物流网络的数据优势、自动驾驶配送对 900 万 dashers 和每年 30 亿配送的影响。完整 transcript（58049 字符）涵盖自动驾驶车辆策略、从人工到混合到自动化的过渡、AI 如何重塑大规模最后一公里配送。
original: 【开场介绍】
主持人：今天 DoorDash 联合创始人 Andy Fang 和 Stanley Tang 在这里。我们聊了 DoorDash 8 年来如何一直是一家机器人公司、网络的数据优势，以及这一切对 900 万 dashers 和每年 30 亿配送意味着什么。
【8 年机器人公司】
DoorDash 在过去 8 年里一直在构建机器人能力——不是从今天开始，而是从第一天就在考虑自动化配送的终局。
【数据优势】
DoorDash 的物流网络产生了海量数据：路线优化、配送时间、商家密度、dashers 行为模式。这些数据是训练自动驾驶配送模型的核心护城河。
【900 万 dashers 与 30 亿配送】
讨论了自动驾驶对现有 dashers 网络的影响——不是替代，而是增强。混合模式（人 + 机器）可能是长期过渡策略。
【最后一公里重塑】
AI 正在重塑大规模最后一公里配送——从路线优化到自动驾驶车辆部署到需求预测。DoorDash 的规模优势使其成为这一转型的核心玩家。
